tracks.title: Open Source Track
tracks.subtitle: Ship a real PR, then apply like a contributor.
tracks.description: The maintainer path. First you land a public pull request. Then you pick an org and write a GSoC / LFX / Outreachy proposal a mentor can mark up.
outcomes: First PR shipped — a public pull request URL from this month
Mentorship application drafted — org pick, proposal, mentor note

tracks.title: Entrepreneur Track
tracks.subtitle: Build the product, then write the company.
tracks.description: The founder path. One studio takes an idea to a live URL. The other writes the brand, the offer, the outreach, and a deck you can say out loud.
outcomes: Idea, customers, live product, brand — from the builder studio
Company written — thesis, offer, outreach, and a spoken pitch

tracks.title: Interview Track
tracks.subtitle: Get into YC startups, reach out, get hired.
tracks.description: Tech-specific hiring studio for good / YC companies. You shortlist on Work at a Startup, send founder notes they actually open, then package shipped work so a founding-engineer interview does not surprise you.
outcomes: Get in — a shortlist of YC / good startups and the role you fit
Reach out — founder notes sent, not just drafted
Get hired — a tech story bank and a weekend take-home plan
